reviewNotes: HOLD — OUM's official 2025 materials publish country-specific tuition figures and describe a hybrid MD curriculum; the university reports PAASCU reaccreditation through 2030. However, no independent current regulator record was established in this pass, and the accessible source bundle does not supply a complete current admissions criteria/deadline, full programme length/cost by cohort, clinical-site allocation terms, visa/residency facts or destination-specific licensure conditions. Marketing statements about possible licensure are not being used as recognition claims.
